title: REQ · PhaserHost computes the zoom on mount and refreshes it on resize and ratio change
summary: PhaserHost uses computeZoom with devicePixelRatio and container size
description: Context: PhaserHost.tsx creates the game with createGame(container, scenes) and the ResizeObserver only refreshes. Desired behavior: compute zoom at mount, pass it to createGame, recompute in the ResizeObserver callback and on devicePixelRatio change, and call scale.setZoom then scale.refresh. Expected result: zoom stays correct as the container or ratio changes. Why: crisp pixels at any size.
acceptance_criteria: Given container clientWidth 1280, clientHeight 720 and dpr 2, when mounted, then createGame is called with third argument computeZoom(1280,720,2)
Given the container size changes, when the ResizeObserver callback fires, then scale.setZoom is called with the new zoom before scale.refresh
Given the dpr changes, when the matchMedia change listener fires, then scale.setZoom is called with the zoom for the new dpr and the listener is removed on unmount
definition_of_done: Zoom passed at creation and refreshed on resize and ratio change
